rule: cut type and work into crossing bands
title: The work, cut together
description: A magenta and citron portfolio zine: cut-out lettering, public app imagery and two crossing streams of project names.
signature: Counter-moving project-name bands cross a collage of Viva Fresh store frames; one pause control stills the whole cover.
holdback: The diagonal bands, cropped Albanian grocery screens and cut-out surname create an actual composition rather than a simple colour swap. Yet the project-name bands are decorative spans, not navigation, and partly obscure the work on both sizes. The visible acid-zine language is familiar, while the author's particular contribution to Viva Fresh remains outside the first viewport.
slopCauses: Giant name with trailing full stop.
Generic role statement supplies the opening developer story.
